50% tuition fee for the first year of undergraduate studies

Nottingham Global Quarter Scholarship 2025 is a global opportunity offered by the University of Nottingham to undergraduate students in the first year of their courses. The main aim of this scholarship is to reward excellence and promote diversity among the student body. The selected candidates will receive a 50% tuition fee for the first year of undergraduate studies.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
have secured a minimum of 60% in the last qualifying examination
The selected candidates will receive a 50% tuition fee for one year of study.
Note:- This is an entrance scholarship. The fees will be waived from students' one-year tuition fees or will be refunded to students if the full tuition fee is paid.
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship by following the below-mentioned steps -

This scholarship will be awarded on a rolling basis until the deadline.
The applicants will be selected and awarded on a first-come-first-served basis until all scholarships are fulfilled.
The scholarship application form can be submitted together with the degree course application form to be considered for both degree and scholarship offers.
The winners of Nottingham Global Scholarships will receive straight forward tuition fee deduction.
The Nottingham Global Scholarships will be on a rolling basis, therefore applicants will be selected and awarded on a first-come-first-served basis until all scholarships are fulfilled.
Students may apply for multiple scholarships but will be considered and entitled to only one entry-based scholarship, with no exception to the family/alumni scholarship.
This is a merit-based scholarship based on the applicant's latest academic achievements. The English language will not be used as a differentiator.
The students are expected to follow the instructions stated on the scholarship offer letter to secure a place after receiving the scholarship.
